Those who stay long at the wine; those who go to seek out mixed wine.
Woe to you, land, when your king is a child, and your princes eat in the morning!
Happy are you, land, when your king is the son of nobles, and your princes eat in due season, for strength, and not for…
On the day of our king, the princes made themselves sick with the heat of wine. He joined his hand with mockers.

“So be careful, or your hearts will be loaded down with carousing, drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day…
Let’s walk properly, as in the day; not in reveling and drunkenness, not in sexual promiscuity and lustful acts, and…
nor thieves, nor covetous, nor drunkards, nor slanderers, nor extortionists, will inherit God’s Kingdom.
envy, murders, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these; of which I forewarn you, even as I also forewarned you, that…
so then let’s not sleep, as the rest do, but let’s watch and be sober.
For those who sleep, sleep in the night; and those who are drunk are drunk in the night.
They also reel with wine, and stagger with strong drink. The priest and the prophet reel with strong drink. They are…

Wine is a mocker and beer is a brawler. Whoever is led astray by them is not wise.

translations.web: Woe to those who rise up early in the morning, that they may follow strong drink, who stay late into the night, until wine inflames them!
translations.bsb: Woe to those who rise early in the morning in pursuit of strong drink, who linger into the evening, to be inflamed by wine.
translations.kjv: Woe unto them that rise up early in the morning, that they may follow strong drink; that continue until night, till wine inflame
translations.asv: Woe unto them that rise up early in the morning, that they may follow strong drink; that tarry late into the night, till wine inflame them!
